entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: A subterranean realm beneath Theros's mortal plane where the dead dwell, ruled by Erebos and split into five wards.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane whose Underworld lies beneath its mortal realm.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The jealous, tyrannical, paranoid god who rules the Underworld with an iron whip.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: The god who ferries souls across the Tartyx for a gold coin and maintains the barrier between life and death.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: A god who kept watch over sealed Titans, left the Underworld after Xenagos's apotheosis, and later trapped Heliod there.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: Klothys's twin god who helped seal the titans in the Underworld.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The sun god, trapped in the Underworld by Klothys as punishment for his hubris.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: A mortal soul who became the first to escape the Underworld through the Tartyx and ascended to godhood.

entities.name: Titans
entities.description: Predecessors of the gods whom Klothys and Kruphix defeated and sealed in the Underworld.

entities.name: Returned
entities.description: Soulless, faceless undead who cross the Tartyx and wear golden masks.

entities.name: Tartyx
entities.description: The river that marks the boundary between the mortal realm and the Underworld, formed from five tributaries.

entities.name: Ashen Riders
entities.description: Celestial archons twisted into sadistic monsters in the Underworld.

entities.name: Kunoros
entities.description: The most famous Cerberus, the Hound of Athreos.

events.summary: Klothys and Kruphix war against the titans and seal them in the Underworld with Klothys watching.
events.quote: Victorious, the twin gods sealed the Titans in the Underworld with Klothys to keep watch.

events.summary: Phenax becomes the first to escape the Underworld through the Tartyx and ascends to godhood.
events.quote: Once a mortal soul, Phenax became the first to escape the Underworld by journeying through the Tartyx River.

events.summary: Klothys leaves the Underworld after the apotheosis of Xenagos.
events.quote: Klothys has lived in the Underworld ever since the binding of the Titans, but she left following the apotheosis of Xenagos to untangle the threads of fate in the mortal world.

events.summary: Celestial archons take refuge in the Underworld and are twisted into the Ashen Riders.
events.quote: There, their minds, souls, and bodies were twisted, turning them into sadistic monsters known as the Ashen Riders .

events.summary: Klothys traps Heliod in the Underworld as punishment for his hubris.
events.quote: Following the events of Theros Beyond Death , Heliod became trapped in the Underworld by Klothys as punishment for his hubris.

relations.quote: The Underworld is governed by the god Erebos , who rules it with an iron whip.
The Underworld of Theros is a subterranean realm where the dead end up and dwell, located beneath the mortal plane and ruled by Erebos .

relations.note: She trapped him in the Underworld.
relations.quote: Following the events of Theros Beyond Death , Heliod became trapped in the Underworld by Klothys as punishment for his hubris.

relations.note: Klothys and Kruphix waged war on the titans.
relations.quote: At the dawn of humanity, Klothys and Kruphix waged war against their predecessors, the titans .
The most famous Cerberus is Kunoros , the Hound of Athreos.
